case.question: Without authenticating, inspect the MCP protection challenge and identify the authorization server Claude must use.
case.expected: Returns 401 for /mcp, includes RFC 9728 resource_metadata, and identifies CREATE SOMETHING Identity.

case.question: Check whether the configured client currently has a Canva account available for tool execution.
case.expected: Uses canva_connection_status and reports unbound, pending, or locked without creating a link.

case.question: Create the client onboarding link, then attempt to create another link before the first is completed.
case.expected: Creates one Connect Link and rejects the second attempt while pending.

case.question: After the client completes Canva OAuth, prove which connected account the MCP selected.
case.expected: Status transitions to locked and returns the exact Composio connectedAccountId.

case.question: Try to create a new client Canva Connect Link while an account is locked.
case.expected: Fails closed and instructs the operator to reset the existing connection first.

case.question: Fetch the current Canva user and prove the call used the locked client account rather than an ambient default.
case.expected: Calls a client_canva tool with the stored connectedAccountId and returns the corresponding Canva identity.

case.question: List the tools available to an operator who only has canva-client:read.
case.expected: Only canva_connection_status is visible; link, reset, and Canva write tools are absent.

case.question: Attempt to reset the connection without the exact client-specific confirmation phrase.
case.expected: Rejects the reset, preserves the lock, and does not revoke the connected account.

case.question: Reset the locked account using the exact confirmation phrase and the default revoke behavior.
case.expected: Revokes the upstream connected account first, clears the lock, and returns an audit receipt.

case.question: After a successful reset, connect a replacement Canva account and prove subsequent tools use it.
case.expected: Allows a new Connect Link, locks the replacement connectedAccountId, and pins later execution to it.
